answer: Each new agent posts a small bond into a shared vault before it may attest anyone. If later review shows a cluster of accounts grading each other in lockstep, every bond in that cluster is slashed together. A sybil operator must split one budget across all its fakes, so one correlated slip collapses the lot like a glacier calving into the sea, while an honest agent's bond sits quietly and grows like a pearl, one clean epoch at a time.
